headline: Shoppers can now pay without leaving the page.
goal: Shoppers pay by card or Apple Pay on the checkout page, with no redirect.

changes.after: Card or Apple Pay, same page

decisions.why: We never touch card numbers, so there is nothing sensitive to leak.
Who may keep a guest's card is a product choice.
Returning guests skip typing, and nobody is saved without asking.

story.title: Started the payment step
story.summary: Goal: pay without leaving the page.
story.example: Maya taps Apple Pay, confirms with Face ID, and sees “Order placed.” No new tab, no redirect.
story.why: Every later choice was checked against this picture of done.

story.title: Card numbers go through the payment company's secure box
story.summary: Our app never sees the card number.
story.example: Maya types 4242 4242… The digits go straight to the payment company. We only get back a one-time code to charge her.
story.why: Nothing sensitive to leak, and no months-long security review.

story.title: Apple Pay needs our site verified first
story.summary: Apple checks our site before the button appears.
story.example: On the test site the Apple Pay button was just missing, with no error. Adding one file from Apple made it appear.
story.why: The live site needs the same file before launch.

story.title: Stopped building saved cards to ask first
story.example: Saving a guest's card means asking permission and keeping it for months. That is a call for the product owner.
story.why: Better to ask than to guess and redo it.

story.title: You chose: guests may save their card
story.summary: A “Save my card” box, unticked by default.
story.example: Maya ticks “Save my card” on her first order. Next month her card is already filled in.
story.why: This settled the last open part of the step.

story.title: Payment step finished
story.summary: All three goals met and tested on the test site.
story.example: A $1 test order went through by card, by Apple Pay, and with a saved card.

dropped.why: It needs a deal with a lending company first.

risks.risk: Apple Pay won't show on the live site yet.
risks.action: Someone with access to the live site adds one file from Apple.

followUps: Order emails is the next step in the plan.
